scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn flickr8k_visualizer.main:app --reload --reload-dir apps/api/src --port 8000
scripts.setup: node scripts/check-setup.mjs && npm install && uv sync --project apps/api --extra dev
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.test:api: uv run --project apps/api --extra dev pytest apps/api/tests
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web && npm run lint:styles
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project apps/api --extra dev ruff check apps/api && uv run --project apps/api --extra dev ruff format --check apps/api
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:api && npm run lint:fix:web && npm run lint:fix:styles
scripts.lint:fix:api: uv run --project apps/api --extra dev ruff check --fix apps/api && uv run --project apps/api --extra dev ruff format apps/api
